flawless: *The Arrogant Wurm yawns, showing rows of teeth, and does not deign to look at you twice.*
*The wurm coils up on top of your scattered deck, as if it had been its bed all along.*
*With a snort of pure disdain, the wurm turns its back on you before your last spell resolves.*
solid: *The wurm flicks a few scraps of your spells off its hide and slithers off, chin held high.*
*Bruised but insufferable, the Arrogant Wurm preens in the sunlight over its victory.*
close: *The Arrogant Wurm pretends it is not panting. It is very much panting.*
*The wurm limps into the brush, glancing back to make sure nobody saw how near a thing that was.*
